entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain. Amounts may exceed warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: High.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 150 to 200 mm of rain about the main divide, and 80 to 120 mm within 20 km farther east. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected about the divide. Freezing level about 3000 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain. Amounts may approach warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Note, rain spreading north during Monday afternoon and easing from the south from evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: Northwest winds may exceed severe gale in exposed places, mainly inland. Impact: Damage to trees, powerlines, and unsecured structures possible. Driving may be difficult, especially for high-sided vehicles and motorcycles. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: High.

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 200 to 300 mm of rain, but 350 mm possible about isolated peaks. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected during Monday afternoon and evening. Note, coastal areas may only get 30 to 60 mm during this period. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.
